description: This file contains unit tests for the 'Eos' (End of Stream) task in a media playback system, specifically testing the behavior of setting end-of-stream signals in a GStreamer-based media pipeline, including handling of stream presence and underflow conditions.

classes.name: EosTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing the Eos task, setting up mock objects and context for each test case.

methods.name: shouldFailWhenStreamIsNotFound
methods.description: Test case verifying behavior when the specified media stream is not found in the context.

methods.name: shouldSetEos
methods.description: Test case verifying successful setting of end-of-stream when stream info is present.

methods.name: shouldFailToSetEos
methods.description: Test case verifying behavior when gstAppSrcEndOfStream returns an error.

methods.name: shouldSetEosForAudioAndCancelAudioUnderflow
methods.description: Test case verifying that underflow is canceled when setting EOS for audio stream with an active underflow.

methods.name: shouldSetEosForAudioAndSkipCancellingVideoUnderflow
methods.description: Test case verifying that video underflow is not canceled when setting EOS for audio stream.

methods.name: shouldSetEosForVideoAndCancelVideoUnderflow
methods.description: Test case verifying that underflow is canceled when setting EOS for video stream with an active underflow.

methods.name: shouldSetEosForVideoAndSkipCancellingAudioUnderflow
methods.description: Test case verifying that audio underflow is not canceled when setting EOS for video stream.
